name: 마르티나
motion_summary: Eternal Return Martina Record: ash-gray long hair, rectangular black glasses, alert amber eyes, ochre/yellow reporter jacket and brown trousers, shoulder video camera exactly per reference. Use the broadcast form of R as representative: she films a cone, builds sequential pulses, ends in a flash. 12 poses: ready with lowered camera; grip camera handle; raise it to shoulder; front knee bends and viewfinder eye aims; filming begins with tiny red recording LED only (NO letters); turn torso slightly left with cyan/violet camera cone outline projecting right; pan slightly right; brace and zoom by adjusting lens with left hand; final bright compact white-gold shutter pulse within cone; recoil a little; camera lowered and jacket settles; ready. Real hand/camera/torso panning motion, not standing still with rotating FX. Glasses yes because original reporter wears them. Beam/cone must end well before cell border, face remains clear.
visual_review: 안경·회색 머리·황색 재킷을 유지합니다. 카메라 들기, 팬, 렌즈 조정과 방송 피날레가 분리됩니다. 촬영 원뿔은 얼굴 우측으로 나갑니다.
